status_labels: certified = rigorous computation run by cert_window.py certify (Arb + exact rationals); each downstream use also needs the cited lemma (Lemma L = the Lipschitz bound of Lemma C.12, Lemma D = Lemma 9.10; Lemma H is not used by the paper)

generator.imports: cert/cert_arb.py (unit_law, classes, mags_interval, ball, bounds, Design.warm/eval_interval/functionals, vp_bracket)

design.name: P
design.disorder: iid J_e in {+1,-1} on every microscopic edge, P(J=-1) = p

law_of_K_H.reference: Proposition 9.3 (magnitudes y_c = m_c, class probabilities alpha_c = P_c, sign rule sgn K_U = s_d; kappa = chi, kappa_2 = chi_2, 1-2p = vartheta there); Lemma C.3 (backbone couplings iid with this law at every beta)
law_of_K_H.unit_magnitudes: m_1 = theta (paths disagree), m_2 = (theta+tau)/(1+theta tau) = tanh(beta+kappa_2) (non-cancel), m_3 = (theta-tau)/(1-theta tau) = tanh(beta-kappa_2) (cancel), kappa_2 = atanh(tau)
law_of_K_H.gadget_law: for n = (n_1,n_2,n_3), n_1+n_2+n_3 = k: weight M(n) P_1^n_1 P_2^n_2 P_3^n_3 with M the multinomial; |tanh K_H| = x_n = theta^2 m_1^n_1 m_2^n_2 m_3^n_3; P(K_H > 0 | n) = (1+A_n)/2, A_n = (1-2p)^2 rho_1^n_1 rho_2^n_2 rho_3^n_3 (132 signed atoms for k = 10)
law_of_K_H.labeling_note: cert/cert_arb.py uses (class 1, class 2, class 3) = (non-cancel, disagree, cancel) = classes (2, 1, 3) of Proposition 9.3; checked exactly by certify

functionals.F(beta,s): E exp(-2 s K_H(beta)) = sum_n M(n) P^n [ (1+A_n)/2 r_n^s + (1-A_n)/2 r_n^(-s) ],  r_n = (1-x_n)/(1+x_n)
functionals.w(beta): min over s in [0,1] of F(beta,s)
functionals.u_H(beta): E tanh|K_H(beta)| = sum_n M(n) P^n x_n
functionals.pbar_H(beta): E[1 - exp(-2|K_H(beta)|)] = sum_n M(n) P^n 2 x_n/(1+x_n)

cell_rule: for beta in [bl, br]: E exp(-2 s K_H(beta)) <= F(bl,s) exp(6 s (beta-bl)) (Lemma L = Lemma C.12, samplewise) <= F_up (2+y)/(2-y) <= W_up <= threshold, where y = 6 s (br-bl) and e^y <= (2+y)/(2-y) for 0 <= y < 2. Checker obligations per cell: F(bl, s) <= F_up (high-precision evaluation at a rational point); the rest is exact rational arithmetic.

W_plus.claim: E exp(-2 s_j K_H(beta)) <= W_STAR for every beta in [beta_1, beta_2] (cell j containing beta), and 2P(W_STAR) < 1

W_two_point.claim: E exp(-2 s_j K_H(beta)) <= W_BB for every beta in [beta_1, beta_2], and 15 W_BB^2 < 1

sharpness_W.status: certified (route-specific point values; not needed downstream)
sharpness_W.meaning: w(beta) >= w_lower at the listed beta, so the same threshold test fails there

hot.claim: pbar_H(beta) < 1/2 and u_H(beta) < 1/3 for all beta in (0, beta_hot]; pbar_H(beta) < 1/3 for all beta in (0, beta_hot3]

monotonicity.lemma: Lemma H (not used by the paper): if 2(b0+2) th^(b0+1) <= 1 - 4 th^(2b0+4) at th = theta_bar >= tanh(B), then m_1, m_2, m_3 hence u_H and pbar_H are nondecreasing on (0, B]

nishimori_line.claim: v_H(gamma(p1)) <= V < vP_lo, h(V) < 1, for each p1; with Lemma D (Lemma 9.10): v_H(gamma(p)) < v_P for every p in (0, p1]
